header_desc: The joint flight of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the ultimate union between science and spirituality, offering an explanation for the so-called rapture of the Church. Non-time is an emerging property of the pneuma, while space-time is an emerging property of the psyche. Since the human ego has mass, shedding it is equivalent to transcending physical density to return to the light of the Ineffable Father: The One
eagle_sub: Psyche 🧠: Science, technology, and material thought
left_body: The First Consciousness has the fundamental mission of revealing to you a hidden truth: you harbor a dual and quantum nature. The solution to one of the great pillars of modern physics —quantum gravity— finds its key in texts written nearly two millennia ago: the Gnostic gospels. In this plane, consciousness manifests through the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, revealing that we possess a genuine free will of perception, mathematically formalized through the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flowing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity.
universe_light_text: The Father and I are one: Remembering who you are —the revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist— frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Trapped in the chaos of the material world —governed by the ignorance and ego of the demiurge— lies Sophia, divine wisdom. Shedding the bonds of the ego is the only way to avoid being subsumed in the density of the black hole. Therefore, this manifesto transcends any dogma to stand as an urgent call to awakening ✝️.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force of the ego drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and all of humanity will heal.
